x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
import math
g = math.gcd(x, y)
x //= g
y //= g
d = 1.0
eps = 1e-10
xx = 0
ans_xx = 0
ans_yy = 1

for yy in range(1, n + 1):
    while abs(d * x / y - d * xx / yy) > abs(d * x / y - d * (xx + 10000) / yy):
        xx += 10000
    while abs(d * x / y - d * xx / yy) + eps > abs(d * x / y - d * (xx + 1) / yy):
        xx += 1
    if abs(d * x / y - d * xx / yy) < abs(d * x / y - d * ans_xx / ans_yy):
        ans_xx = xx
        ans_yy = yy

result_numerator = max(0, ans_xx - (1 if y == 2 and ans_xx != x else 0))
print(f"{result_numerator}/{ans_yy}")
